literal: Will you obtain dignity, O heart, by telling the cruel one about the distress of my wasting shoulders?
translation: O my heart! Will you gain any dignity by going and telling that cruel man about the distress of my wasting shoulders?
modern: நெஞ்சே! என் வாடுகின்ற தோள்களின் துன்பத்தைப் பற்றி அந்த இரக்கமற்றவரிடம் போய்ச் சொல்வதால் நீ ஏதேனும் பெருமையைப் பெறுவாயோ?
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks to her own heart, which is eager to seek out her departed lover. She calls him 'the cruel one' (கொடியார்) because he left her to pine in separation. Her shoulders have grown thin and wasted (வாடுதோள்) from grief, causing a visible distress or clamor (பூசல்). She asks her heart if there is any dignity or self-respect (பாடு) to be gained by exposing her pathetic state to someone who was unfeeling enough to leave her.
